Disseminations of Reports / "Londo Ireng" social network analysis at X/Twitter

"Londo Ireng" social network analysis at X/Twitter

Published 19 October 2026

Ishak Martins, Adisty Ramadhani

Download PDF

Introduction

Around mid-July, we recorded the term and mentions of "Londo Ireng" in X/Twitter. We tracked this particular keyword across multiple days to document public reaction regarding the use of the term "Londo Ireng" by the Indonesian government officials to describe people and organisations that criticise major government policies. This report is a test drive of our software modules and practice for our data visualisation styles.

Findings

  • The dataset holds 13,680 tweets from 6,996 unique accounts between 22/07/2026 07:15 and 31/07/2026 00:12 GMT+7. These tweets drew 715,185 likes, 223,736 retweets, 23,985 comments and 962,906 engagement.
  • Replies make up 8,335 of the 13,680 tweets. Original posts count 3,127 and quote tweets count 2,218.
  • Ten accounts post the highest tweet counts: TaeYeontan7 305, 0x8i9w1n 199, KunyilIreng 149, thecoolsanti 113, LondoSpark 105, falsebaymax 89, Apocalypse93760 88, londo402 75, SodaranyaNunez 72 and munajat_ade1 58.
  • The words ireng and londo appear 11,050 and 11,010 times. The next words by count are prabowo 1,258, presiden 1,037, dia 965, rakyat 810, asing 798, bukan 789, orang 705 and antek 674. Hashtags #londoireng 441 and #viral 105 lead the tag counts, followed by #prabowo 48, #prabowosubianto 47, #jangangagalpaham 34 and #loyalitasuntukbangsa 26.
  • Stance labels on 13,680 tweets mark 4.1% as Agrees, 12.9% as Disagrees and 83.0% as Not related to H1 on the term Londo Ireng as a term for government critics.
  • The evidence tiers assign 5,654 accounts to T0 (No signals), 1,235 to T1 (Burst participation only), 107 to T2 (Metadata-suspicious) and 0 to T3 (Coordinated) across 6,996 accounts. The dataset records 17 burst hours, with the busiest hour at 24/07/2026 16:00 GMT+7 and 214 tweets. These tiers describe evidence found in the dataset; proof of automation, payment or coordination sits outside the dataset.

Remarks

We have no remarks for this report.

Amplification

Source: Kestrel Parts D and E. 6,996 accounts. Tiers describe evidence found in this dataset. They are not a claim that an account is automated, paid or coordinated.

Evidence tiers

Accounts per evidence tier

T0No signals
5,654 accounts, 81%

Nothing in this corpus separates this account from ordinary participation.

T1Burst participation only
1,235 accounts, 18%

The account posted inside an amplification burst and nothing else fired. Never filtered: posting during a spike is what an interested human does too.

T2Metadata-suspicious
107 accounts, 2%

At least two independent evidence families fired (burst-exclusive posting, creation inside a creation burst, extreme profile metadata, high near-duplicate/self-repetition).

T3Coordinated
0 accounts, 0%

This account sits in a cluster that stayed outside the permutation null after FDR correction. The strongest evidence tier, and the only one the de-amplified corpus removes by default.
